units.source_text: 我感觉哥哥的声音里有一种前所未有的温柔。

en.t: I felt a tenderness in my brother's voice that I had never heard before.

units.source_text: 但是，世界上没有比哥哥更别扭的人了。

en.t: But there was no one in the world more awkward and contrary than my brother.

units.source_text: 刚刚还感性温柔的对我说话，忽然又恢复了平日的冷漠，

en.t: Though he had just been speaking to me with emotion and tenderness, he suddenly returned to his usual coldness,

units.source_text: 威胁说：“如果不乖一点听话的话，就随便你。

en.t: and threatened me, saying, "If you will not behave and listen to me, then do as you please.

units.source_text: 但是你给我小心点，不然我让你很难看。”

en.t: But you had better watch yourself, or I will make things very unpleasant for you."
